scripts: clean app profile, no user scripts installed
symptom_under_test: persistent white text and image regions on the Yahoo News category after returning from an article

normal_navigation.applied: only the changed foreground preview item
normal_navigation.bfcache: enabled and confirmed via the app's setting

normal_navigation.remaining_observation: Next category rendered after the last main-news article. No separate frame verified return to the main-news category for this cycle.

excluded_trials: The first fixed-delay rapid driver could issue Back before detail rasterization. It then mistook the Android launcher wallpaper for Yahoo's blue category strip. Those trials are excluded.
inference_limit: The old deferred capture crossing navigation is reproduced separately. This does not establish that the capture is the sole cause of the persistent visual loss on the reported Galaxy. No physical Galaxy was tested.

screen_confirmed_comparison.app: all five Berry items, Android 17 API 37, WebView 158.0.8127.2; both trials confirmed BFCache enabled via the app settings; no user scripts installed
screen_confirmed_comparison.driver: Confirmed the Berry foreground activity, rendered article and category identity. On rapid cycles issued Back after waiting 740 ms from actual article visibility. Compared category pixels and scrolled the returned page.

previous_1_0_383.evidence: The seventh rapid return lost the hero photo and one headline while the row and metadata remained. After scrolling, several headlines and category labels were missing.

preview_only_fix_1_0_384_in_full_configu.next_rapid_return: URL returned to the entertainment category but only blue navbar background and partial elements painted; persisted for the full 20-second wait
preview_only_fix_1_0_384_in_full_configu.evidence: During the eighth normal return the hero image and two lower headlines were missing. The bad raster persisted into the next cycle, which opened a real article.

screen_confirmed_comparison.result: The preview race fix alone does not resolve the reported rendering failure. The old version and the 1.0.384 build both reproduced it on the emulator.
